question: Among product categories (English names) with at least 500 delivered order items, which category has the highest share of late-delivered items (delivered after the estimated date)?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.order_id,
        oi.product_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        p.product_category_name,
        ct.product_category_name_english
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    JOIN products p USING (product_id)
    JOIN category_translation ct USING (product_category_name)
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_name_english AS category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_items,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_items
    FROM delivered
    GROUP BY product_category_name_english
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
)
SELECT
    category,
    late_items::DOUBLE / total_items AS late_share
FROM agg
ORDER BY late_share DESC
LIMIT 1
plan:
- Identify delivered order items by joining order_items to orders where order_status = 'delivered'.
- Join to products to get product_category_name, then to category_translation for the English name.
- Determine if each item is late by comparing order_delivered_customer_date to order_estimated_delivery_date.
- Aggregate per English category: count total delivered items and count late items.
- Filter categories with total delivered item count >= 500.
- Compute late share as late count / total count.
- Select the category with the maximum late share.
